note: Wooded family campground at 1522 Fruitvale Rd E near Holton, across the road from the public boat ramp and swim area on 372-acre Big Blue Lake, at the edge of the Manistee National Forest; the White River and a canoe livery are a mile away. Rental cabins and trailers (2-night minimum) besides the RV sites. Pin is on the site loop under canopy, matched to the street address. Not on RV Life; Good Sam 8/7/7.7 (appeal/facility/general, unstarred); Google 4.8 over 133 reviews. --Claude
